input_schema.description: Parameters of a method that takes none. Unknown fields are ignored.
input_schema.title: Empty

LibraryEntry.description: One entry of a user data library (`profile.list`, `collection.list`; protocol 1.4).

id.description: Its stable id, passed to `profile.switch` and `collection.switch`.

name.description: Its name, unique in the library ignoring case.

output_schema.description:
The output profiles or scene collections (`profile.list`, `collection.list`;
protocol 1.4).

current.description: The id of the one in use.

pending.description:
A switch asked for through the control API is still being made. Once it is
false, a `current` other than the id asked for means the app refused the
switch or could not load the entry (its error line says why).

output_schema.title: Library
